name: Femme Osage Creek
places: August A. Busch Memorial Conservation Area
about: Femme Osage Creek drains about 16 square miles, all of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 740 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 460 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Femme Osage Creek and Little Femme Osage Creek. Downstream, its water passes through the Wildhorse Creek-Missouri River, Greens Chute-Missouri River and Duckett Creek-Missouri River watersheds on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
